[Book a 7-day Readout](https://bouncewatch.com/book?from=company_sidebar) ### Discover More United States Market [Market Signals](https://bouncewatch.com/market-signals/united-states) [All Companies](https://bouncewatch.com/companies-in-united-states) [All Signals](https://bouncewatch.com/signals) [Trend Reports](https://bouncewatch.com/trends) ## About Typeface **Typeface**, founded in **2022** and headquartered in the **United States**, is positioned as a transformative force in the marketing technology landscape. Its innovative approach as a "marketing orchestration engine" integrates **Marketing**, **Creative**, and **IT** teams to streamline the content lifecycle. The company empowers large enterprises by facilitating seamless collaboration through its platform, ensuring alignment with brand standards while enhancing quality and control. The platform's core pillars— **Arc Graph**, **Arc Forge**, **Arc Agents**, and **Arc Spaces**—offer robust solutions for brand intelligence, agent workflows, and campaign management, supporting integration with major platforms like **Salesforce**, **Microsoft**, and **Google**. Notably, **Fortune 500** companies and brands like **ASICS** and **Johnson Controls** have benefited from their AI-driven workflows. In **June 2023**, Typeface secured a **$100.00M Series B** round led by prominent investors including **Madrona**, **Lightspeed Venture Partners**, **GV**, **M12**, **Menlo Ventures**, and **Salesforce Ventures**, underscoring its strategic potential and technological promise.
